brief: Inspect Camden Works 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-781) and clear any vegetation or obstruction encroaching on the ventilation openings or radiator banks, giving clearance work precedence over other remedial activity as specified in SOP-011. Reduce permissible load in accordance with MG-021 by assessing the average ambient over the 24 hours preceding the loading decision against the reference average of 30 degrees. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period pursuant to MG-021.
